messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "this amount corresponds to one or two 50 mg tablets"
set: ["this amount corresponds to one or two 50 mg tablets", "this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses", "eight 50 mg tablets a day", "one or two months into treatment", "achieved with one 30 mg capsule or two 15 mg capsules", "50 mg to 100 mg", "50 to 100 mg", "50 mg", "100 mg a day, as one dose or split into two", "taken as one dose or split into two", "taking two 7 mg tablets to achieve 14 mg dose is not recommended", "do not take two 10 mg tablets at once", "50 mg to 200 mg a day", "50 mg tablet", "common starting dose is one 50 mg tablet a day", "target dose is equivalent to one 50 mg tablet four times a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
